zh: 明年我打算换一份自己更喜欢的工作。
old_en: Next year, I'm going to switch to a job I like better.
new_en: Next year, I want to change to a job I like more.

zh: 明年我想带父母去旅行。
old_en: Next year, I'm going to take my parents on a trip.
new_en: Next year, I plan to take my parents on a trip.

zh: 明年我打算养一只狗。
old_en: Next year, I'm going to get a dog.
new_en: Next year, I want to get a dog.

zh: 以后我想养一只狗，现在住的地方太小。
old_en: In the future, I plan to get a dog when my place gets bigger.
new_en: In the future, I want to get a dog, but my place is too small now.

zh: 今年我打算考一个证书。
old_en: This year, I'm going to take a certificate exam.
new_en: This year, I want to take a certificate exam.

zh: 我计划今年考一个证书，对工作有帮助。
old_en: This year, I plan to take a certificate exam for my job.
new_en: This year, I plan to take a certificate exam to help my job.

zh: 以后我打算少加一点班。
old_en: In the future, I'm going to work fewer overtime hours.
new_en: In the future, I plan to work less overtime.

zh: 我计划以后少加班，多陪家人。
old_en: I plan to work less overtime in the future to spend more time with my family.
new_en: I want to spend more time with my family and work less overtime next year.

zh: 以后我打算每周自己做一次饭。
old_en: I'm going to cook dinner for myself once a week after this.
new_en: I plan to cook for myself once a week from now on.

zh: 明年我计划换工作，想试试新的方向。
old_en: Next year, I plan to switch jobs and try a new path.
new_en: Next year, I want to change jobs and try a new direction.

zh: 今年我打算开始存钱买房。
old_en: I'm going to start saving money this year to buy a house.
new_en: This year, I plan to start saving money to buy a house.

zh: 我今年计划多存点钱，争取早点买房。
old_en: I plan to save more this year to buy a house sooner.
new_en: I plan to save more money this year to buy a house sooner.

zh: 明年我打算学一门新语言。
old_en: Next year, I plan to learn a new language.
new_en: Next year, I plan to learn a new language.

zh: 我计划明年开始学一门新语言。
old_en: I plan to start learning a new language next year.
new_en: I plan to start learning a new language next year.

zh: 明年我打算带父母出去旅行一次。
old_en: I'm going to take my parents out for a trip next year.
new_en: Next year, I plan to take my parents on a trip.

zh: 下个月我打算开始健身。
old_en: Next month, I plan to start exercising.
new_en: Next month, I plan to start working out.

zh: 我计划下个月开始健身，每周去三次。
old_en: I'm going to start working out next month, hitting the gym three times a week.
new_en: I plan to start exercising next month, three times a week.

zh: 明年我打算搬到离公司近一点的地方。
old_en: Next year, I plan to move to a place closer to the office.
new_en: Next year, I plan to move closer to my workplace.

zh: 我准备明年搬家，住得离公司近一些。
old_en: I plan to move next year to be closer to the office.
new_en: I plan to move next year to live closer to my workplace.

zh: 我计划从下个月开始，每周做一次饭。
old_en: I plan to cook once a week starting next month.
new_en: I plan to start cooking once a week starting next month.
